tha-ap104:2.1: obhāsentaṁ → obhāsantaṁ (bj) | Obhāsentaṁ → M. G. -bhāsantaṁ. (pts note)

tha-ap104:2.3: rathiyaṁ → rathiyā (pts) | rathiyā → G. ratiyā; M. rathi. (pts note)
tha-ap104:2.4: apassahaṁ → apassisaṁ (bj); naruttamaṁ (sya-all, pts) | apassisaṁ → ajassihaṁ (bj: sīmu)
tha-ap104:3.4: siddhatthamabhivādayiṁ catunnavutito → siddhatthaṁ abhivādayiṁ catunavute ito (bj, sya-all, pts) | abhivādayiṁ → G. abhivādayi. (pts note)
